$comment: Metric definitions for the agent_routing experiments (plan 4.4). Event names match harness/schema.py. Enum literals are the Admin API values; setup.sh and forkbill init check every one against the target instance's OPTIONS choices before creating anything.

api_literals.$comment: Choices read from OPTIONS on self-hosted Flagsmith 2.295.2, 2026-11-27. Docs only list occurrence/up/increase. Re-confirmed per run by the preflight check.

metrics.name: task_cost
metrics.description: US dollars per task, sent for every exposed task including capped and failed ones. Lower is better.

metrics.name: task_solved
metrics.description: Sent only when every FAIL_TO_PASS and PASS_TO_PASS test passes. Should not decrease.
